messages:
maya: Heads-up — noticed p95 token latency spike for /chat/complete on eu-west yesterday around 21:10 UTC. Seems correlated with kernel handoffs when KV cache miss rate climbs.

liam: @maya can you paste the rough query that surfaced it? metrics or logs?

maya: here's the quick PromQL I used:
```
max_over_time(route_latency_token_p95{route="/chat/complete",region="eu-west"}[1h])
```
p95 jumped from 85ms -> 220ms for ~15m window. :eyes:

sasha: Do we have kernel switch logs in telemetry? I remember we emit kernel_choice and handoff_duration

perf-bot: auto-report: kernel_choice_transition_count{route="/chat/complete",from="fast_attention",to="compat"} = 128

liam: That matches kernel fallback; batching heuristic started queuing longer tails, then we hit cold KV cache and the runtime switched kernels to a compat path that doesn't support in-place KV warmed lookups.

maya: I looked at token waterfall traces — the extra ~120ms is split: 30-50ms handoff + 60-80ms KV fetch misses + GC pauses on host sporadically.

sasha: For the Console per-route KPIs I'd like to show a stacked token latency breakdown (compute_kernel, handoff, kv_miss, network, other) for p50/p95/p99. Helps ops decide whether it's kernel or infra.

liam: Agree. Minimal fields: route, model, region, kernel_choice, kv_hit_rate, batching_bucket, p50/p95/p99_token_latency, throughput_rps, error_rate. Also need sample_count and alertable flags.

maya: UX ask: add a small toggle to overlay kernel transition events on the timeline so you can correlate spikes to handoffs.

sasha: Implementation notes:
- telemetry: emit token_component_latency histogram per-request with labels {route, kernel_choice, batching_bucket}
- ingest: sample token-level histograms into Console with reservoir sampling for p99 stability
- dashboard: stacked bars per percentile + throughput sparklines + kv_hit_rate gauge

liam: Also we should expose a "warmup score" heuristic per-route: fraction of requests hitting KV warm prefix within first N tokens. That can be used to tune batch warmup.

maya: Example query for kv hit rate:
```
sum(rate(kv_cache_hit_total{route="/chat/complete"}[5m]))
/
sum(rate(kv_cache_request_total{route="/chat/complete"}[5m]))
```

sasha: For alerts: create thresholded signal when p99_token_latency increases > 2x baseline AND kv_hit_rate < 0.7 AND kernel_transition_count > 10 in 10m.

liam: Are we planning to backfill? For models with no token histograms we'll fallback to per-request token_p95 and approximate breakdown via sampling.

maya: I'll prototype the dashboard tiles and add a mock dataset. Will post screenshots in next thread.

sasha: Awesome. Can you add a small note in the telemetry schema so onboarding teams know the labels and cardinality constraints? We should cap batching_bucket to <= 8 values.

perf-bot: scheduled follow-up reminder set for 2024-11-05 15:00 UTC — thread owners: maya, liam

liam: Thanks all. I'll open infra PR to emit kernel transition events with route tag.

maya: thx :thumbsup:
